from build123d import *

# ----- dimensions (mm) -----
overall_len = 79.9          # total length (drawing)
tip_len     = 12.0          # length of the pointed tip
blade_h     = 8.0           # blade height (front view)
blade_t     = 2.5           # blade thickness
guard_len   = 7.0           # cross-guard length along axis
guard_h     = 11.7          # cross-guard height (end view)
guard_t     = 4.5           # cross-guard width  (end view)
grip_len    = 20.0          # grip length ("20" dimension)
grip_h      = 5.0           # grip height
grip_t      = 2.5           # grip thickness
fillet_r    = 0.9           # R0.9 on the cross-guard
slot_w      = 1.6           # fork slot width
slot_depth  = 14.0          # fork slot depth from the end

blade_len = overall_len - guard_len - grip_len   # length of blade body

# ----- pointed blade (profile in XZ, extruded in Y) -----
pts = [(0.0, 0.0),
       (tip_len, blade_h / 2.0),
       (blade_len, blade_h / 2.0),
       (blade_len, -blade_h / 2.0),
       (tip_len, -blade_h / 2.0)]
blade_profile = make_face(Plane.XZ * Polyline(*pts, close=True))
blade = extrude(blade_profile, amount=blade_t / 2.0, both=True)

# ----- cross-guard with R0.9 fillets on its axial edges -----
guard = Box(guard_len, guard_t, guard_h)
guard = fillet(guard.edges().filter_by(Axis.X), fillet_r)
guard = Pos(blade_len + guard_len / 2.0, 0, 0) * guard

# ----- grip -----
grip = Pos(blade_len + guard_len + grip_len / 2.0, 0, 0) * Box(grip_len, grip_t, grip_h)

part = blade + guard + grip

# ----- fork slot at the free end of the grip -----
slot = Pos(overall_len - slot_depth / 2.0, 0, 0) * Box(slot_depth, grip_t * 3.0, slot_w)
part = part - slot

part.name = "pegasus_pin"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# Overall envelope
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
body_width = 80.0          # X  (overall width)

body_thickness = 1.3       # Z  (plate thickness)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# U pocket (opening toward the front / -Y face)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
pocket_width = 51.7
pocket_depth = 43.4        # leaves a 8.3 mm top rail
pocket_z = -0.55

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Snap-latch tabs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
tab_width = 1.0
tab_height = 2.6
tab_depth = 0.6
tab_z = 0.25               # 1.3 mm latch overall height

# top rail tabs (4x) - 20 mm pitch, 13.4 mm from each end
top_tab_xs = [-36.6, -13.4, 13.4, 36.6]

# side rail tabs (3x) - 23.1 mm pitch, 1.3 mm from the side edges
side_tab_ys = [-21.8, 0.0, 21.8]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.1 mm through clearance holes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hole_dia = 1.1

# top rail (4x) - 20 mm pitch, 13.4 mm from each end
top_hole_xs = [-36.6, -13.4, 13.4, 36.6]

# side rails (3x) - 23.1 mm pitch, 1.3 mm from the side edges
side_hole_ys = [-21.8, 0.0, 21.8]

# bottom corners (4x) - 15.9 mm from each end, 1.3 mm from the bottom edge
corner_xs = [-34.1, 34.1]
corner_y = -23.7

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0.5 mm chamfer on the bottom edge
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
chamfer_size = 0.5

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as clip:
    # 80 x 51.7 x 1.3 mm base plate
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Rectangle(body_width, body_depth)
    extrude(amount=body_thickness)

    # ---- U pocket (through, opening toward -Y) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(pocket_z)):
        with Locations((0, -body_depth / 2 + pocket_depth / 2)):
            Rectangle(pocket_width, pocket_depth)
    extrude(amount=body_thickness + 0.7, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- snap-latch tabs ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(tab_z)):
        # top rail tabs
        with Locations(*[(x, body_depth / 2 + tab_depth / 2) for x in top_tab_xs]):
            Rectangle(tab_width, tab_height)
        # side rail tabs
        for x in (-body_width / 2 - tab_depth / 2, body_width / 2 + tab_depth / 2):
            with Locations(*[(x, y) for y in side_tab_ys]):
                Rectangle(tab_width, tab_height)
    extrude(amount=tab_height)

    # ---- 1.1 mm through clearance holes ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations(
            # top rail
            *[(x, body_depth / 2) for x in top_hole_xs],
            # side rails
            *[(x, y) for x in (-body_width / 2, body_width / 2) for y in side_hole_ys],
            # bottom corners
            *[(x, corner_y) for x in corner_xs],
        ):
            Circle(hole_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=body_thickness + 0.2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- chamfer the bottom edge (C0.5) ----
    bottom_edges = clip.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[:1]
    chamfer(bottom_edges, chamfer_size)

# Dimensions taken from the target drawing (image 1)
thickness      = 4.6          # side view

top_width      = 20.7         # arrow-head width
stem_width     = 5.6          # A/F of the narrow stem

boss_radius    = boss_dia / 2
taper_height   = 20.0         # estimated arrow-head height
fillet_r       = 1.5          # 3x R1.5
hole_dia       = 8.0          # double-D through hole
hole_af        = 4.7          # across flats

with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- front profile in XZ plane ---------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        # bottom circular boss centred on origin
        Circle(boss_radius)

        # tapered lever body with arrow-head top

            Polyline(
                (-base_width / 2, 0),
                (-stem_width / 2, total_height - taper_height),
                (-top_width  / 2, total_height),
                ( top_width  / 2, total_height),
                ( stem_width / 2, total_height - taper_height),
                ( base_width / 2, 0),

from build123d import *

# ---------- Envelope ----------
plate_width     = 80.0
plate_height    = 58.0
plate_thickness = 4.9
corner_radius   = 2.9

# ---------- Hole / slot pitches ----------
pitch_xy    = 19.3
small_pitch = 20.0

# ---------- Base plate ----------
part = Box(plate_width, plate_thickness, plate_height)
part = fillet(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), corner_radius)

def through_hole(x, z, dia):
    return Pos(x, 0, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(dia / 2, plate_thickness + 10)

def through_slot(x, z, length, width):
    """Vertical slot (long axis along Z) cut through the plate."""
    sk = SlotOverall(length, width)
    cut = extrude(sk, plate_thickness + 10)
    # SlotOverall in XY plane: length along X. Rotate so length becomes vertical (Z),
    # then position, then translate to pass through the plate.
    return Pos(x, -(plate_thickness + 10) / 2, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * cut

# ---------- 12x D18.3 THRU  (4 cols x 3 rows) ----------
for i in range(4):
    for j in range(3):
        x = (i - 1.5) * pitch_xy
        z = (j - 1.0) * pitch_xy
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 18.3)

# ---------- 6x D5.8 THRU  (3 cols x 2 rows) ----------
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(2):
        x = (i - 1.0) * pitch_xy
        z = (j - 0.5) * pitch_xy
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 5.8)

# ---------- 6x D3.9 THRU  (2 cols x 3 rows) ----------
for i in range(2):
    for j in range(3):
        x = (i - 0.5) * (2 * pitch_xy)
        z = (j - 1.0) * small_pitch
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 3.9)

# ---------- 8x D2.9 THRU at lattice nodes ----------
for x in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, 1.5 * pitch_xy):
    for z in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, -0.5 * pitch_xy,
              0.5 * pitch_xy,  1.5 * pitch_xy):
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 2.9)

# ---------- 4x SLOT 7.8 x 28.8 (vertical, long axis Z) ----------
for x in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, 1.5 * pitch_xy):
    for z in (-1.0 * pitch_xy, 1.0 * pitch_xy):
        part -= through_slot(x, z, 28.8, 7.8)

# ---------- 6x SLOT 7.8 x 9.5 ----------
for x in (-2.5 * pitch_xy, 0.0, 2.5 * pitch_xy):
    for z in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, 1.5 * pitch_xy):
        part -= through_slot(x, z, 9.5, 7.8)

part.name = "perforated_plate"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Gear parameters (target OD = 65, 28 teeth) ----
num_teeth    = 28
outer_dia    = 65.0
module       = outer_dia / (num_teeth + 2)      # ~2.167
pitch_dia    = module * num_teeth
addendum     = module
dedendum     = 1.25 * module
outer_radius = outer_dia / 2.0
root_radius  = pitch_dia / 2.0 - dedendum
circular_pitch = math.pi * module

gear_thickness = 10.0

# ---- Shaft parameters (ø10 throughout, total 80) ----
shaft_dia = 10.0
shaft_r   = shaft_dia / 2.0
seg_top   = 20.0    # above gear
seg_bot1  = 40.0    # middle below gear
seg_bot2  = 10.0    # bottom tip

gear_top_z  =  gear_thickness / 2.0
gear_bot_z  = -gear_thickness / 2.0
shaft_top_z =  gear_top_z + seg_top
shaft_bot_z =  gear_bot_z - seg_bot1 - seg_bot2

# ---------- Gear body as 2D profile ----------
gear_2d = Circle(root_radius)

base_half = circular_pitch * 0.30
tip_half  = circular_pitch * 0.11

for i in range(num_teeth):
    ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / num_teeth)
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)

    def rr(x, y):
        return (x * ca - y * sa, x * sa + y * ca)

    p1 = rr(root_radius - 0.05, -base_half)
    p2 = rr(outer_radius,       -tip_half)
    p3 = rr(outer_radius,        tip_half)
    p4 = rr(root_radius - 0.05,  base_half)

    tooth_edge = Polyline((p1[0], p1[1], 0),
                          (p2[0], p2[1], 0),
                          (p3[0], p3[1], 0),
                          (p4[0], p4[1], 0),
                          close=True)
    tooth_face = make_face(tooth_edge)
    gear_2d = gear_2d + tooth_face

gear_body = extrude(gear_2d, gear_thickness)
gear_body = Pos(0, 0, -gear_thickness / 2.0) * gear_body

# ---------- Shaft ----------
shaft = Pos(0, 0, (shaft_top_z + shaft_bot_z) / 2.0) * \
        Cylinder(shaft_r, shaft_top_z - shaft_bot_z)

part = gear_body + shaft

# ---------- Hex socket 7 A/F at top ----------
hex_r = 7.0 / math.sqrt(3.0)          # circumradius for 7 across flats
hex_depth = 6.0
hex_face = RegularPolygon(hex_r, 6).face()
hex_socket = Pos(0, 0, shaft_top_z - hex_depth) * extrude(hex_face, hex_depth)
part = part - hex_socket

# ---------- 4 x 26.6 deg top chamfer on shaft ----------
top_edges = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:]
try:
    part = chamfer(top_edges, length=0.5)   # ~26.6 deg chamfer
except Exception:
    pass

# ---------- 2 x R1 fillet on tooth top edges ----------
tooth_edges = [
    e for e in part.edges()
    if abs(e.center().Z - gear_top_z) < 0.01
    and math.hypot(e.center().X, e.center().Y) > root_radius - 0.5
]
try:
    part = fillet(tooth_edges, 1.0)
except Exception:
    pass

# ---------- Bottom tip chamfer ----------
bot_edges = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).sort_by(Axis.Z)[:1]
try:
    part = chamfer(bot_edges, length=0.5)
except Exception:
    pass

part.name = "gear"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

p_right  = ( bracket_width / 2, bracket_length / 2)
p_apex   = ( 0.0, -bracket_length / 2)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- outer triangular profile (rounded top corners) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line(p_left, p_right)
            a1 = ThreePointArc(l1 @ 1,
                               ( bracket_width / 2 + 5, bracket_length / 2 - 5),
                               ( bracket_width / 2 - 5, bracket_length / 2 - 10))
            l2 = Line(a1 @ 1, p_apex)
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, p_left)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bracket_thickness)

    # ---- three radial stiffening ribs ----
    # rib from left vertex to centre
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as rib1_sk:
        with BuildLine() as rib1_bl:
            rl1 = Line(p_left, (0, 0))
            rl2 = Line(rl1 @ 1, ( 4,  2))
            rl3 = Line(rl2 @ 1, rl1 @ 0)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bracket_thickness)

    # rib from right vertex to centre
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as rib2_sk:
        with BuildLine() as rib2_bl:
            rl1 = Line(p_right, (0, 0))
            rl2 = Line(rl1 @ 1, (-4,  2))

        with BuildLine() as rib3_bl:
            rl1 = Line(p_apex, (0, 0))
            rl2 = Line(rl1 @ 1, (-4, -2))
            rl3 = Line(rl2 @ 1, rl1 @ 0)

import math

# ---------------- Overall envelope ----------------
clip_length    = 80.0      # overall width
rect_height    = 30.0      # straight-wall height
peak_height    = 10.7      # apex above rect_height  -> total 40.7
clip_thickness = 2.9

# ---------------- Large thru-holes ----------------
large_hole_d  = 18.9
left_hole_x   = 21.4
right_hole_x  = 58.6
large_hole_y  = 22.3                       # 22.3 from bottom edge

# ---------------- Small thru-holes (on 37.1 BC) ----------------
small_hole_d  = 1.6
bc_d          = 37.1
bc_r          = bc_d / 2.0
small_angles  = [90.0, 210.0, 330.0]       # EQ SP around each large hole

# ---------------- Bottom notches ----------------
notch_width   = 12.0
notch_depth   = 3.0
notch_spacing = 30.0                       # centers at 25 and 55

# ---------------- Fillets ----------------
fillet_outer  = 2.9
fillet_small  = 0.7

# ================= Build =================
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (0.0, 0.0),
                (clip_length, 0.0),
                (clip_length, rect_height),
                (clip_length / 2.0, rect_height + peak_height),
                (0.0, rect_height),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=clip_thickness)

part = p.part

# --- cut the two bottom notches first ---
for nx in [clip_length/2 - notch_spacing/2, clip_length/2 + notch_spacing/2]:
    part = part - Pos(nx, 0.0, clip_thickness/2) * Box(notch_width, notch_depth*2, clip_thickness*2)

# --- large thru-holes ---
for hx in (left_hole_x, right_hole_x):
    part = part - Pos(hx, large_hole_y, clip_thickness/2) * \
                  Cylinder(large_hole_d/2.0, clip_thickness*2)

# --- small thru-holes, polar array on ⌀37.1 BC per large hole ---
for hx in (left_hole_x, right_hole_x):
    for ang_deg in small_angles:
        a  = math.radians(ang_deg)
        sx = hx + bc_r * math.cos(a)
        sy = large_hole_y + bc_r * math.sin(a)
        part = part - Pos(sx, sy, clip_thickness/2) * \
                      Cylinder(small_hole_d/2.0, clip_thickness*2)

# --- 4x R2.9 : outer profile corners (bottom-L, bottom-R, top-L, top-R) ---
corner_pts = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (clip_length, 0.0),
    (0.0, rect_height),
    (clip_length, rect_height),
]
outer_edges = []
for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z):
    m = e.center()
    for cx, cy in corner_pts:
        if abs(m.X - cx) < 0.5 and abs(m.Y - cy) < 0.5:
            outer_edges.append(e)
            break

if outer_edges:
    part = fillet(outer_edges, fillet_outer)

# --- remaining 0.7 fillets (notch inner corners + hole edges) ---
remaining = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
try:
    part = fillet(remaining, fillet_small)
except Exception:
    pass

part = part.clean()
part.name = "clip"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_diameter = 80.0          # Ø80 outer cylinder
inner_diameter = 60.3          # Ø60.3 inner cylinder (bore)
length = 64.2                  # overall axial length

groove_diameter = 77.9         # Ø77.9 circumferential groove on outer surface
groove_width = 3.5             # axial width of the groove
groove_position = 45.0         # groove center from the plain (bottom) end

spline_count = 12              # internal splines
spline_root_diameter = 33.0    # diameter at the spline roots
spline_tip_diameter = 45.0     # diameter at the spline tips
spline_length = 40.0           # axial extent of the splined region
spline_start = 12.0            # splined region starts 12 mm from plain end

slot_width = 2.5               # axial slot width (split)
slot_depth = 4.0               # radial depth of the slot

chamfer_size = 0.8             # chamfer on the top rim edges

# derived radii
outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
groove_radius = groove_diameter / 2.0
spline_root_radius = spline_root_diameter / 2.0
spline_tip_radius = spline_tip_diameter / 2.0
spline_depth = spline_tip_radius - spline_root_radius

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- main body: outer cylinder with Ø60.3 bore -------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (outer_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (inner_radius, length))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (inner_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # ---- Ø77.9 circumferential groove on the outer surface ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(groove_position)) as sk_g:
        Circle(outer_radius)
        Circle(groove_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=groove_width / 2.0, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- internal splines (12 teeth) ---------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(spline_start)) as sk_s:
        Circle(spline_root_radius)
        with PolarLocations(spline_tip_radius, spline_count):
            Rectangle(spline_depth, spline_depth, mode=Mode.ADD)
    extrude(amount=spline_length)

    # ---- axial split slot --------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, outer_radius - slot_depth / 2.0, 0)):
        Box(slot_width, slot_depth, length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# chamfer the top rim edges
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
top_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
p.part = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_h)) as s1:
        RegularPolygon(step1_dia / 2, 6, rotation=30)
    extrude(amount=step1_h)

        RegularPolygon(step1_dia / 2, 6, rotation=30)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_h + step1_h + step2_h)) as s3:

taper = 0.90               # width/height shrink per step

# ---- One stepped tapered arm (base at z = 0, extruded to z = arm_length) ----
def make_arm():
    steps = int(arm_length / step_h) + 1
    with BuildPart() as p:
        for i in range(steps):
            w = arm_width * taper ** i
            h = arm_height * taper ** i
            z = i * step_h
            if z > arm_length:
                break
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(z)) as s:
                Rectangle(w, h)
        # short taper to the tip
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(arm_length)) as s_tip:
            Rectangle(arm_width * taper ** steps, tip_h)
        loft()
    arm = p.part
    # fillet the edges at the arm root (bottom face perimeter)
    root_edges = arm.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[:4]
    arm = fillet(root_edges, root_fillet)
    return arm

# Slotted tray - IRIS-1556
# envelope 80 x 80 x 10.1, wall / floor 1.3
# 10 + 10 slots 3.4 wide, 36.8 (upper) / 37.1 (lower), pitch 6.7

    # upper row : 36.8 long, lower row : 37.1 long, central band between

blade_r_in = 8.0                             # start clear of hub hole
blade_r_out = 34.9                           # per 69.8 dia reference
blade_ang = 8.0                              # angular width (deg)
blade_skew = 30.0                            # pinwheel twist (deg)
blade_depth = 1.2

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- revolved disc with fully rounded (pill) rim ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as prof:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((-rim_radius, 0.0), (-rim_radius, outer_radius - rim_radius))
            ThreePointArc((-rim_radius, outer_radius - rim_radius),
                          (0.0, outer_radius),
                          (rim_radius, outer_radius - rim_radius))
            Line((rim_radius, outer_radius - rim_radius), (rim_radius, 0.0))
            Line((rim_radius, 0.0), (-rim_radius, 0.0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

    # ---- central Ø8 thru hole ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        Circle(hole_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=thickness, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 7 blade whirl relief on the front face ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane(origin=(thickness / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0), z_dir=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))) as gs:
        for i in range(blade_count):

                  ro * math.sin(math.radians(a + blade_skew + blade_ang)))
            p4 = (ri * math.cos(math.radians(a + blade_ang)),
                  ri * math.sin(math.radians(a + blade_ang)))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)  -  vertical rectangular panel with a regular grid of
# through "keyhole" slots and a single row of through mounting holes
# along the top edge.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
panel_width = 80.0          # overall width (X)
panel_height = 55.4         # overall height (Z)
panel_thickness = 7.4       # panel thickness (Y)

slot_major = 19.2           # keyhole slot overall length
slot_minor = 10.9           # keyhole slot width (= round end diameter)
slot_rows = 2               # number of slot rows
slot_cols = 5               # number of slot columns
slot_pitch_x = 15.4         # horizontal slot pitch
slot_pitch_z = 26.3         # vertical slot pitch

mount_hole_dia = 2.5        # through mounting hole diameter
mount_hole_count = 5        # number of mounting holes
mount_hole_spacing = 15.4   # mounting hole pitch
mount_hole_offset_z = 19.2  # mounting hole row height above panel centre

fillet_radius = 0.6         # edge round on every slot / hole edge

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Keyhole profile (in the XZ plane, centred at the origin)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as kp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0, -slot_major / 2 + slot_minor / 2)):
            Rectangle(slot_minor, slot_major - slot_minor)   # straight stem
        with Locations((0, slot_major / 2 - slot_minor / 2)):
            Circle(slot_minor / 2)                            # rounded head
    extrude(amount=panel_thickness / 2, both=True)
keyhole_solid = kp.part

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mounting-hole profile (axis along Y, centred at the origin)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
mount_solid = Cylinder(mount_hole_dia / 2, panel_thickness)
mount_solid = Rot(90, 0, 0) * mount_solid

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble the panel
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # flat panel blank
    Box(panel_width, panel_thickness, panel_height)

    # regular grid of through keyhole slots
    for i in range(slot_cols):
        for j in range(slot_rows):
            x = (i - (slot_cols - 1) / 2) * slot_pitch_x
            z = (j - (slot_rows - 1) / 2) * slot_pitch_z
            with Locations((x, 0, z)):
                add(keyhole_solid, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # single row of through mounting holes along the top edge
    for i in range(mount_hole_count):
        x = (i - (mount_hole_count - 1) / 2) * mount_hole_spacing
        with Locations((x, 0, mount_hole_offset_z)):
            add(mount_solid, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # round every edge of every slot and hole (44 x R0.6)
    hole_edges = []
    for e in p.edges():
        try:
            r = e.radius
        except Exception:
            continue
        if abs(r - slot_minor / 2) < 1e-3 or abs(r - mount_hole_dia / 2) < 1e-3:
            hole_edges.append(e)
    fillet(hole_edges, fillet_radius)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

chamfer_rim  = 0.4   # 6 x C0.4

# ---------------- Shell (open top) ----------------
outer = Box(L, W, H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
inner = Pos(0, 0, t_bot) * Box(L - 2 * t_side, W - 2 * t_side, H,
                               align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
part = outer - inner

# ---------------- Ribs ----------------
inner_len = L - 2 * t_side
inner_wid = W - 2 * t_side
cell_len = (inner_len - n_ribs * rib_t) / (n_ribs + 1)

rib_xs = []
xr = -inner_len / 2 + cell_len + rib_t / 2
for _ in range(n_ribs):
    rib_xs.append(xr)
    xr += cell_len + rib_t

for xr in rib_xs:
    part += Pos(xr, 0, H / 2) * Box(rib_t, inner_wid, H)

# ---------------- Pockets in the floor (36 x R1.7) ----------------
cell_centers = []
xc = -inner_len / 2 + cell_len / 2
for _ in range(n_ribs + 1):
    cell_centers.append(xc)
    xc += cell_len + rib_t

y0 = -(n_rows - 1) / 2 * pocket_pitch_y
for xc in cell_centers:
    for r in range(n_rows):
        yc = y0 + r * pocket_pitch_y
        pocket = Pos(xc, yc, t_bot - pocket_depth / 2) * Box(pocket_x, pocket_y, pocket_depth)
        pocket = fillet(pocket.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), pocket_fillet)
        part -= pocket

# ---------------- C0.3 on outer vertical edges ----------------
vert_edges = [
    e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if abs(abs(e.center().X) - L / 2) < 1e-3 and abs(abs(e.center().Y) - W / 2) < 1e-3
]
if vert_edges:
    try:
        part = chamfer(vert_edges, chamfer_vert)
    except Exception:
        pass

# ---------------- C0.4 on the outer top rim ----------------
top_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
rim_edges = [e for e in top_face.edges()
             if abs(abs(e.center().X) - L / 2) < 1e-6
             or abs(abs(e.center().Y) - W / 2) < 1e-6]
if rim_edges:
    try:
        part = chamfer(rim_edges, chamfer_rim)
    except Exception:
        pass

export_step(part, "output.step")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
sheet = 3.8          # sheet thickness

# hub
hub_a = 19.0         # horizontal radius
hub_b = 22.0         # vertical radius
hub_cx = 19.3        # centre x (from left edge)

# tab
tab_x0 = 34.0        # left edge of tab
tab_x1 = 75.2        # right edge of tab (tip)
tab_zb = -6.7        # bottom of tab
tab_zt = 0.0         # top of tab

# keyhole through slot
slot_x0 = 0.0        # left edge of slot
slot_x1 = 22.0       # right edge of slot
slot_zb = -6.3
slot_zt = 0.0

# mounting holes
hole_z = -14.0
hole_x = 30.1
hole_d = 5.7

# small through holes
small_z = 0.0
small_x1 = 64.1
small_x2 = 72.6
small_d = 4.4

# end treatment
tip_chamfer = 1.6
edge_fillet = 0.9

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- hub + tab profile (front view = XZ plane) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        # hub (ellipse)
        with Locations((hub_cx, 0)):
            Ellipse(hub_a, hub_b)
        # tab
        with Locations(((tab_x0 + tab_x1) / 2.0, (tab_zb + tab_zt) / 2.0)):
            Rectangle(tab_x1 - tab_x0, tab_zt - tab_zb)
    extrude(amount=sheet)

    # ---- keyhole through slot ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk_slot:
        with Locations(((slot_x0 + slot_x1) / 2.0, (slot_zb + slot_zt) / 2.0)):
            Rectangle(slot_x1 - slot_x0, slot_zt - slot_zb)
        with Locations((slot_x1, (slot_zb + slot_zt) / 2.0)):
            Circle((slot_zt - slot_zb) / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=sheet, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- mounting hole ----
    with Locations((hole_x, sheet / 2.0, hole_z)):
        Cylinder(hole_d / 2.0, sheet, rotation=(90, 0, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- small through holes ----
    for x in (small_x1, small_x2):
        with Locations((x, sheet / 2.0, small_z)):
            Cylinder(small_d / 2.0, sheet, rotation=(90, 0, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- chamfer tip corner edges (run along the sheet thickness) ----
    tip_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).sort_by(Axis.X)[-2:]
    chamfer(tip_edges, tip_chamfer)

    # ---- fillet the remaining vertical (thickness-direction) edges ----
    vert_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
    fillet(vert_edges, edge_fillet)

hex_center_radius = 28.0   # distance from plate center to window centers

    ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / num_windows)

    e for e in solid.edges()
    if abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6

def star_points(scale):
    """Star vertices, first point up (90 deg), outer/inner alternating."""
    pts = []
    for i in range(2 * points):
        angle = math.pi / 2.0 + i * math.pi / points
        r = outer_radius if i % 2 == 0 else inner_radius
        pts.append((scale * r * math.cos(angle), scale * r * math.sin(angle)))
    return pts


with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as base_sk:
        Polygon(*star_points(1.0), align=None)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)) as top_sk:
        Polygon(*star_points(top_scale), align=None)
    loft()

part = p.part
part.name = "star_frustum"

lobe_count = 12                # number of lobes

            extrude(amount=thickness)

    # central hexagonal through-hole
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)) as hex_sk:
        RegularPolygon(hex_vertex_radius, 6)
    extrude(amount=-thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

                (inner_radius * 0.55, slot_width * 0.5),

with BuildPart() as p:

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(
                (-width / 2, -length / 2),
                (width / 2, -length / 2),
                (width / 2, length / 2),
                (-width / 2, length / 2),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()

    fillet(p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), corner_radius)

    # ---- hollow it out (thin-walled shell) -------------------------
    top_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]

from build123d import *
import math

# ---------------- Drawing dimensions ----------------
overall_width   = 80.0                        # 80.0 overall envelope
half_width      = overall_width / 2.0         # 40.0  centre -> boss OD
bolt_circle_dia = 53.0                        # O53.0 BC
bolt_circle_r   = bolt_circle_dia / 2.0       # 26.5
boss_radius     = half_width - bolt_circle_r  # 13.5
hub_radius      = 15.0
hole_dia        = 19.1                        # O19.1 THRU (centre + 4 on BC)
thickness       = 6.1
flute_r         = 1.1                         # 64x R1.1
flutes_per_boss = 16                          # 4 x 16 = 64

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ---- base cloverleaf plate : hub + 4 bosses on the 53 BC ----
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        Circle(hub_radius)
        with PolarLocations(bolt_circle_r, 4):
            Circle(boss_radius)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # ---- 64 x R1.1 peripheral flutes (16 around each boss) ----
    # offset by half a pitch so a full-radius peak sits at 0/90/180/270
    # -> keeps the overall envelope exactly 80.0 (no flute cutting the extreme)
    flute_pos = []
    for i in range(4):
        a = math.radians(90.0 * i)
        cx = bolt_circle_r * math.cos(a)
        cy = bolt_circle_r * math.sin(a)
        for j in range(flutes_per_boss):
            t = math.radians(360.0 * (j + 0.5) / flutes_per_boss)
            flute_pos.append((cx + boss_radius * math.cos(t),
                              cy + boss_radius * math.sin(t), 0.0))
    with Locations(*flute_pos):
        Cylinder(flute_r, thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- holes : 1 central + 4 on bolt circle, all O19.1 thru ----
    hole_pos = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]
    for i in range(4):
        a = math.radians(90.0 * i)
        hole_pos.append((bolt_circle_r * math.cos(a),
                         bolt_circle_r * math.sin(a), 0.0))
    with Locations(*hole_pos):
        Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part
part.name = "fluted_cross_plate"
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
plate_thickness = 8.0          # plate thickness (z)

centroid_y = tri_height / 3.0  # centroid of the triangular blank

pocket_diameter = 30.0         # central through pocket diameter
pocket_center_y = centroid_y   # pocket centered on the centroid

# concentric grooved ring (annulus) on the top face
groove_inner_r = 25.0
groove_outer_r = 27.0
groove_depth = 2.0

# mounting through holes at each vertex
hole_diameter = 4.0
hole_positions = [
    (-half_base, 0.0),
    (half_base, 0.0),
    (0.0, tri_height),
]

# small chamfer on outer rim / pocket rim
edge_chamfer = 0.8

# small fillet on the pocket floor (inner top rim)
pocket_fillet = 0.7

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- triangular plate ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (-half_base, 0.0),
                (half_base, 0.0),
                (0.0, tri_height),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # ---- central through pocket ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations((0.0, pocket_center_y)):
            Circle(pocket_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- shallow concentric grooved ring on top face ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness)):
        with Locations((0.0, pocket_center_y)):
            Circle(groove_outer_r)
            Circle(groove_inner_r, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=-groove_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- mounting holes at the three vertices ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations(*hole_positions):
            Circle(hole_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ---- small fillet on the pocket floor (inner top rim) ----

    e
    for e in solid.edges()
    if abs(e.center().Z - plate_thickness) < 0.2
    and abs(e.center().Y - pocket_center_y) < 2.0
    and abs(e.center().X) < 2.0
]

    solid = fillet(floor_edges, pocket_fillet)

overall_height  = 29.2     # overall height of the C-channel
web_thickness   = 5.6      # thickness of the left web
flange_thickness = 5.6     # thickness of top / bottom flanges
depth           = 77.9     # extrusion depth
fillet_radius   = 1.2      # small radius on all edges

clearance_hole_dia = 4.9   # clearance holes
hole_cols          = 3
hole_rows          = 5
hole_spacing_x     = 9.7   # horizontal pitch
hole_spacing_y     = 11.7  # vertical pitch

# --- Build the C-channel profile and extrude ---
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            # Left web: x = 0 .. web_thickness, y = 0 .. overall_height
            Polyline((0, 0), (web_thickness, 0))
            # Bottom flange: y = 0 .. flange_thickness, x = web_thickness .. overall_width
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (overall_width, 0))
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (overall_width, flange_thickness))
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (web_thickness, flange_thickness))
            # Inner web: x = web_thickness, y = flange_thickness .. overall_height - flange_thickness
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (web_thickness, overall_height - flange_thickness))
            # Top flange: y = overall_height - flange_thickness .. overall_height
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (overall_width, overall_height - flange_thickness))
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (overall_width, overall_height))
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (0, overall_height))
            Polyline(bl.line @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=depth)

solid_body = p.part

# --- Fillet all edges ---
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

# --- Clearance hole grid on the bottom flange ---

    for j in range(hole_rows):
        x = bottom_flange_center_x + (i - (hole_cols - 1) / 2) * hole_spacing_x
        z = depth / 2.0 + (j - (hole_rows - 1) / 2) * hole_spacing_y
        hole = Pos(x, bottom_flange_center_y, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(

arm_pts = [
    (-6.0, 0.0),
    (-neck_hw, 9.0),
    (-neck_hw - 1.0, 16.0),
    (-pad_hw, 25.0),
    (-pad_hw + 0.5, 31.0),
    (-tip_hw, half_len),
    ( tip_hw, half_len),
    ( pad_hw - 0.5, 31.0),
    ( pad_hw, 25.0),
    ( neck_hw + 1.0, 16.0),
    ( neck_hw, 9.0),
    ( 6.0, 0.0),
]

angles = (0, 90, 180, 270)

def rot(pts, ang):
    a = radians(ang)
    return [(x * cos(a) - y * sin(a), x * sin(a) + y * cos(a)) for (x, y) in pts]

# concave roots of the +Y arm (arm side edge x hub top edge)

    with BuildSketch() as sk:

            Polygon(*arm_pts, align=None, rotation=ang)

        # ---- 4x R9.7 concave fillets at the arm roots ----
        junc_targets = []
        for ang in angles:
            junc_targets.extend(rot(junc_pts, ang))
        big_sel = []
        for (px, py) in junc_targets:
            for v in sk.vertices():
                if (v.X - px) ** 2 + (v.Y - py) ** 2 < 0.25:
                    big_sel.append(v)
                    break
        if len(big_sel) == len(junc_targets):
            try:
                fillet(big_sel, r_big)
            except Exception:

        # ---- R2.6 fillets on every remaining profile vertex ----
        small_targets = [(hub_half, hub_half), (-hub_half, hub_half),

                     if any((v.X - px) ** 2 + (v.Y - py) ** 2 < 0.25
                            for (px, py) in small_targets)]
        fillet(small_sel, r_small)

    # thin plate
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # rounded top / bottom rims
    fillet(bp.part.edges().filter_by(Plane.XY), r_small)

    # ---- holes ----
    Cylinder(center_hole_dia / 2, thickness * 3, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    hole_pos = [(0, bc_r, 0), (bc_r, 0, 0), (0, -bc_r, 0), (-bc_r, 0, 0)]

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- controlling dimensions from drawing ----
thickness     = 7.5
fillet_radius = 1.9
hole_dia      = 23.6
bc_radius     = 55.8 / 2.0      # 27.9  (3x EQ SP ON ø55.8 BC)
hex_r         = 16.13           # tuned so envelope = 80.0 x 69.8
hub_r         = 14.5            # central boss tying lobes together

lobe_angles = [30.0, 150.0, 270.0]   # two on top, one at bottom

def hexagon_pts(r):
    return [(r*math.cos(math.radians(60*i)),
             r*math.sin(math.radians(60*i))) for i in range(6)]

def lobe_xy(ang):
    a = math.radians(ang)
    return (bc_radius*math.cos(a), bc_radius*math.sin(a))

# ---- build 2D profile ----
with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
    with Locations((0, 0)):
        Circle(hub_r)
    for ang in lobe_angles:
        x, y = lobe_xy(ang)
        with Locations((x, y)):
            Polygon(*hexagon_pts(hex_r), align=None)

    # For each hexagon, the 4 OUTWARD vertices (farthest from origin) get R1.9.
    # The 2 inner vertices (nearest to origin) stay sharp -> total = 12 fillets.
    fillet_targets = []
    for ang in lobe_angles:
        cx, cy = lobe_xy(ang)
        verts = [(cx + vx, cy + vy) for (vx, vy) in hexagon_pts(hex_r)]
        verts_sorted = sorted(verts, key=lambda p: math.hypot(p[0], p[1]))
        fillet_targets.extend(verts_sorted[2:])   # drop the 2 nearest-to-origin

    verts_to_fillet = []
    for v in sk.vertices():
        for (tx, ty) in fillet_targets:
            if abs(v.X - tx) < 1e-3 and abs(v.Y - ty) < 1e-3:
                verts_to_fillet.append(v)
                break

    fillet(verts_to_fillet, fillet_radius)

# ---- extrude & holes ----
with BuildPart() as bp:
    add(sk.sketch)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    for ang in lobe_angles:
        x, y = lobe_xy(ang)
        with Locations((x, y, 0)):
            Cylinder(hole_dia/2.0, thickness*2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(hole_dia/2.0, thickness*2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part.name = "three_lobes_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

outer = 80.0            # outer square size

hole_offset = 35.0      # mounting hole offset from center

pocket_d = 1.8          # pocket diameter
pocket_pitch = 15.0     # pocket grid pitch

chamfer_size = 0.3      # pocket chamfer

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- outer box (z = 0 .. cap_h) ----
    Box(outer, outer, cap_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- hollow interior (open top) ----
    with Locations((0, 0, base_t)):
        Box(inner, inner, cap_h - base_t,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- two crossing interior ribs (z = base_t .. base_t + rib_h) ----
    rib_z = base_t + (cap_h - base_t - rib_h) / 2
    with Locations((0, 0, rib_z)):
        Box(inner, rib_t, rib_h,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    with Locations((0, 0, rib_z)):
        Box(rib_t, inner, rib_h,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- four straight slots in the base ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_t)):
        with Locations((slot_offset, 0), (-slot_offset, 0),
                       (0, slot_offset), (0, -slot_offset)):
            SlotOverall(slot_l, slot_w)
    extrude(amount=base_t, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- four mounting holes through the side walls ----
    for x, y in ((hole_offset, 0), (-hole_offset, 0),
                 (0, hole_offset), (0, -hole_offset)):
        with Locations((x, y, cap_h / 2)):
            Cylinder(hole_d / 2, cap_h + 1,
                     rotation=(0, 90, 0) if x != 0 else (90, 0, 0),
                     mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- regular array of small circular pockets (etched) ----
    n = int(inner // pocket_pitch) + 1
    span = (n - 1) * pocket_pitch
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            x = -span / 2 + i * pocket_pitch
            y = -span / 2 + j * pocket_pitch
            with Locations((x, y, base_t + (wall_t + 0.2) / 2)):
                Cylinder(pocket_d / 2, wall_t + 0.2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- chamfer the pocket rims ----
    pocket_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
        if abs(e.radius - pocket_d / 2) < 1e-6
    ]
    if pocket_edges:

corner_bc_radius  = 66.2 / 2                          # 33.1  (hole bolt circle)
corner_hole_dia   = 10.9                              # 5x thru
corner_boss_dia   = 15.8                              # corner lobe
center_hole_dia   = 14.6                              # thru
corner_fillet     = 1.5                               # 12x R1.5
slot_corner_r     = 0.7                               # 49x R0.7

# edge rib / slot pattern

slot_len          = 20.0
slot_w            = 2.2
slot_gap          = 3.4
slot_row_offset   = 2.0

vertex_angles = [90 + 72 * i for i in range(5)]
inradius      = circum_radius * math.cos(math.radians(36))

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        # pentagon outline, vertex up
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*[(circum_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
                        circum_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a)))
                       for a in vertex_angles], close=True)
        make_face()
        fillet(sk.vertices(), corner_fillet)

        # 5 corner bosses (oe15.8)
        with Locations(*[(corner_bc_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
                          corner_bc_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a)))
                         for a in vertex_angles]):
            Circle(corner_boss_dia / 2)

        # slot rows along each pentagon edge
        for a in vertex_angles:
            mid = a + 36
            mx = inradius * math.cos(math.radians(mid))
            my = inradius * math.sin(math.radians(mid))
            for j in range(slot_count):
                off = slot_row_offset + j * slot_gap
                px = mx - off * math.cos(math.radians(mid))
                py = my - off * math.sin(math.radians(mid))

                    RectangleRounded(slot_len, slot_w, slot_corner_r,
                                     rotation=mid + 90)

    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # corner holes oe10.9 thru
    with Locations(*[(corner_bc_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
                      corner_bc_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a)), 0)
                     for a in vertex_angles]):
        Cylinder(corner_hole_dia / 2, plate_thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    Cylinder(center_hole_dia / 2, plate_thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Parameters from drawing ----
thickness        = 5.0
overall_width    = 80.0
half_width       = overall_width / 2.0               # 40.0
bolt_circle_dia  = 64.4
lobe_hole_dia    = 10.7
central_hole_dia = 15.8
fillet_radius    = 1.4
oct_circum_r     = 4.0
oct_pos_r        = 20.0

# ---- Derived lobe / waist geometry ----
d = bolt_circle_dia / 2.0            # 32.2  (lobe hole centre radius)
# Lobe radius chosen so total horizontal width matches 80.0
R = half_width - d * math.cos(math.radians(30))      # ~12.11
w = 22.0                             # waist radius (concave side depth)

R_s = (d*d + w*w - R*R - d*w) / (2*R - 2*w + d)
y   = w + R_s

angles_deg = [90.0, 210.0, 330.0]
centers = [(d*math.cos(math.radians(a)), d*math.sin(math.radians(a))) for a in angles_deg]

def sub(a, b): return (a[0]-b[0], a[1]-b[1])
def add(a, b): return (a[0]+b[0], a[1]+b[1])
def scl(a, s): return (a[0]*s, a[1]*s)
def nrm(a):    return math.hypot(a[0], a[1])

side_centers = []
for i in range(3):
    c1 = centers[i]
    c2 = centers[(i + 1) % 3]
    mid = ((c1[0]+c2[0]) * 0.5, (c1[1]+c2[1]) * 0.5)
    side_centers.append(scl(mid, y / nrm(mid)))

lobe_tan_prev, lobe_tan_next = [], []
for i in range(3):
    c = centers[i]
    v1 = sub(side_centers[(i - 1) % 3], c); vn1 = nrm(v1)
    v2 = sub(side_centers[i], c);           vn2 = nrm(v2)
    lobe_tan_prev.append(add(c, scl(v1, R / vn1)))
    lobe_tan_next.append(add(c, scl(v2, R / vn2)))

waist_pts = []
for i in range(3):
    Oa = side_centers[i]
    vn = nrm(Oa)
    waist_pts.append(scl(Oa, w / vn))

out_pts = []
for i in range(3):
    c = centers[i]
    vn = nrm(c)
    out_pts.append(add(c, scl(c, R / vn)))

# ---- Build the plate ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            for i in range(3):
                j = (i + 1) % 3
                ThreePointArc(lobe_tan_prev[i], out_pts[i], lobe_tan_next[i])
                ThreePointArc(lobe_tan_next[i], waist_pts[i], lobe_tan_prev[j])
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

part = p.part

# ---- Central hole ----
part -= Cylinder(central_hole_dia / 2.0, thickness * 3.0)

# ---- Three lobe holes on the bolt circle ----
for c in centers:
    part -= Pos(c[0], c[1], 0) * Cylinder(lobe_hole_dia / 2.0, thickness * 3.0)

# ---- Three octagonal holes between the centre and each lobe ----
for a in angles_deg:
    ar = math.radians(a)
    x, yy = oct_pos_r * math.cos(ar), oct_pos_r * math.sin(ar)
    with BuildPart() as oct_p:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
            with Locations((x, yy)):
                RegularPolygon(oct_circum_r, 8)
        extrude(amount=thickness * 3.0)
    part -= oct_p.part

# ---- R1.4 fillets on all top and bottom face edges (30 x R1.4) ----
sel_edges = [e for e in part.edges()
             if abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-3 or abs(e.center().Z - thickness) < 1e-3]
try:
    part = fillet(sel_edges, fillet_radius)
except Exception:
    top_edges = part.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    try:
        part = fillet(top_edges, fillet_radius)
    except Exception:
        pass

part.name = "three_lobe_plate"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------

hub_outer_r       = 20.0     # central hub outer radius
hub_inner_r       = 10.8     # central through bore radius (Ø21.6)
lobe_center_r     = 28.0     # lobe centre distance from hub centre
lobe_outer_r      = 16.0     # lobe outer radius
lobe_inner_r      = 10.8     # lobe through bore radius (Ø21.6)
dimple_r          = 3.0      # shallow concave dimple radius
dimple_depth      = 0.8      # dimple depth
dimple_offset     = 14.0     # dimple centre distance from lobe centre
edge_chamfer      = 0.4      # chamfer on vertical edges

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # flat plate outline: hub + 3 lobes on a 120 deg bolt circle
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(hub_outer_r)
        with PolarLocations(lobe_center_r, 3, start_angle=90.0):
            Circle(lobe_outer_r)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # through bores: hub + 3 lobes
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(hub_inner_r)
        with PolarLocations(lobe_center_r, 3, start_angle=90.0):
            Circle(lobe_inner_r)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # shallow concave dimples on the top face, two per lobe
    for i in range(3):
        a = math.radians(90.0 + i * 120.0)
        px = lobe_center_r * math.cos(a)
        py = lobe_center_r * math.sin(a)
        for s in (-1.0, 1.0):
            rot = a + s * math.radians(45.0)
            cx = px + dimple_offset * math.cos(rot)
            cy = py + dimple_offset * math.sin(rot)
            with Locations((cx, cy, plate_thickness - dimple_depth / 2)):
                Cylinder(dimple_r, dimple_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    vertical_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    chamfer(vertical_edges, edge_chamfer)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ envelope
outer_size = 80.0          # 80.0 across flats
height     = 66.7          # overall height
wall       = 5.3           # wall thickness

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ vents
slot_w      = 10.6         # 10.6 wide (horizontal)
slot_h      = 2.7          # 2.7 high
slot_depth  = 1.3          # 1.3 deep
slot_pitch  = 8.0          # 3x 8.0 vertical pitch
slot_count  = 4            # 4 slots per column
col_offset  = 20.0         # two columns 40.0 apart per face

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ body
part = Box(outer_size, outer_size, height)

# 4x C10.7 vertical corner chamfers
part = chamfer(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), 10.7)

# hollow centre, open at top -> 5.3 wall

part = offset(part, amount=-wall, openings=[top_face])

# 16x R1.1 internal fillets along the inner floor
z_floor = -height / 2 + wall
bottom_edges = [e for e in part.edges() if abs(e.center().Z - z_floor) < 0.2]
if bottom_edges:
    try:
        part = fillet(bottom_edges, 1.1)
    except Exception:
        pass

# 20x C1.1 on the top rim
top_edges = part.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
try:
    part = chamfer(top_edges, 1.1)
except Exception:
    pass

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ vents
for i in range(slot_count):
    z = (i - (slot_count - 1) / 2) * slot_pitch
    for s in (-1, 1):
        tang = s * col_offset
        # +X and -X faces
        for sx in (1, -1):
            cut = Pos(sx * outer_size / 2, tang, z) * Box(2 * slot_depth, slot_w, slot_h)
            part = part - cut
        # +Y and -Y faces
        for sy in (1, -1):

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_span = 80.0            # outer span of the grid (both directions)
grid_depth = 9.6               # plate thickness
web_thickness = 1.9            # constant web / rib thickness

pocket_count = 3               # 3 x 3 open pockets
pocket_size = 23.1             # square pockets between the webs
pocket_pitch = 25.0            # centre-to-centre pocket spacing

boss_radius = 2.4              # round boss at each web intersection
boss_height = 14.5             # total height of a boss (protrudes below plate)

boss_rows = pocket_count + 1   # 4 x 4 boss field
boss_pitch = pocket_pitch      # bosses sit on the web intersections

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Horizontal webs (run along X)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part = None
for k in range(pocket_count + 1):
    y = (k - pocket_count / 2) * pocket_pitch
    web = Pos(0, y, grid_depth / 2) * Box(overall_span, web_thickness, grid_depth)
    part = web if part is None else part + web

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Vertical webs (run along Y)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for k in range(pocket_count + 1):
    x = (k - pocket_count / 2) * pocket_pitch
    web = Pos(x, 0, grid_depth / 2) * Box(web_thickness, overall_span, grid_depth)
    part = part + web

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Cut the square pockets between the webs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in range(pocket_count):
    for j in range(pocket_count):
        x = (i - (pocket_count - 1) / 2) * pocket_pitch
        y = (j - (pocket_count - 1) / 2) * pocket_pitch
        pocket = Pos(x, y, grid_depth / 2) * Box(pocket_size, pocket_size, grid_depth)
        part = part - pocket

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Round bosses at the web intersections
#    (stand proud of the plate bottom face)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in range(boss_rows):
    for j in range(boss_rows):
        x = (i - (boss_rows - 1) / 2) * boss_pitch
        y = (j - (boss_rows - 1) / 2) * boss_pitch
        boss = Pos(x, y, grid_depth - boss_height / 2) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_height)
        part = part + boss

    hole_centres.append((bolt_circle_r * math.cos(a), bolt_circle_r * math.sin(a)))

        Circle(plate_radius)

import math

# ---------------- Parameters ----------------
arm_count = 5                     # 5-fold flower (matches ISO view)
arm_bolt_radius = 32.0            # center -> arm-boss center
arm_boss_radius = 19.1 / 2        # ø19.1 rounded arm ends
hub_radius = 23.0                 # central web
valley_dist = 34.0                # petal-notch center radius
valley_cut_radius = 15.0          # petal-notch radius
thickness = 7.2
center_hole_radius = 19.3 / 2     # ø19.3 THRU
chamfer_dist = 1.2                # C1.2
hex_across_flats = 9.0
hex_depth = 5.0

# One arm points straight up (+Y), 5-fold symmetry
arm_angles = [90 - 72 * i for i in range(arm_count)]
valley_angles = [a - 36 for a in arm_angles]

# ---------------- Base outline ----------------
with BuildSketch() as sk:
    Circle(hub_radius)
    for a in arm_angles:
        rad = math.radians(a)
        with Locations((arm_bolt_radius * math.cos(rad),
                        arm_bolt_radius * math.sin(rad))):
            Circle(arm_boss_radius)
    # concave petal notches between arms
    for a in valley_angles:
        rad = math.radians(a)
        with Locations((valley_dist * math.cos(rad),
                        valley_dist * math.sin(rad))):
            Circle(valley_cut_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = extrude(sk.sketch, amount=thickness)

# ---------------- Cuts ----------------
# Central through hole
part -= Cylinder(center_hole_radius, thickness * 2)

# Hexagonal sockets in each arm (cut from the top face)
hex_r = hex_across_flats / math.sqrt(3)
hex_prism = extrude(RegularPolygon(hex_r, 6), amount=hex_depth)
for a in arm_angles:
    rad = math.radians(a)
    x = arm_bolt_radius * math.cos(rad)
    y = arm_bolt_radius * math.sin(rad)
    part -= Pos(x, y, thickness - hex_depth) * hex_prism

top_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
bottom_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
try:
    part = chamfer(top_face.edges() + bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_dist)
except Exception:

hole_head_diameter = 11.6
hole_head_angle = 90

pocket_radius = 8.8            # 4× Ø17.6 THRU
pocket_pattern_radius = 19.2   # Ø38.4 BC

# ---- build the disc ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Line((0, 0), (0, thickness))
            Line((0, thickness), (outer_diameter / 2, thickness))
            Line((outer_diameter / 2, thickness), (outer_diameter / 2, 0))
            Line((outer_diameter / 2, 0), (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

# central shaft bore
solid_body -= Pos(0, thickness / 2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(shaft_bore_diameter / 2, thickness)

# four counterbored mounting holes
csk_r = hole_head_diameter / 2
csk_h = csk_r / math.tan(math.radians(hole_head_angle / 2))
bore_r = hole_diameter / 2

for i in range(4):
    a = math.radians(i * 360.0 / 4)
    px = hole_pattern_radius * math.cos(a)
    pz = hole_pattern_radius * math.sin(a)
    solid_body -= Pos(px, thickness / 2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(bore_r, thickness)
    solid_body -= Pos(px, thickness - csk_h / 2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cone(csk_r, 0, csk_h)

# four large through pockets
for i in range(4):
    a = math.radians(45 + i * 360.0 / 4)
    px = pocket_pattern_radius * math.cos(a)
    pz = pocket_pattern_radius * math.sin(a)
    solid_body -= Pos(px, thickness / 2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(pocket_radius, thickness)

import math

# ---- dimensions (mm) ----
disc_diameter = 80.0      # outer diameter of the disc
disc_thickness = 10.0     # base disc thickness
fin_height = 20.0         # fin height above the disc
fin_thickness = 2.0       # radial thickness of each fin
fin_count = 30            # number of fins
slot_width = 4.0          # width of the radial split slot
chamfer_distance = 0.2    # small chamfer on fin top edges

disc_radius = disc_diameter / 2.0
fin_outer_radius = disc_radius
fin_inner_radius = fin_outer_radius - fin_thickness
fin_center_radius = (fin_inner_radius + fin_outer_radius) / 2.0

# ---- base disc ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(disc_radius)
    extrude(amount=disc_thickness)

result = p.part

# ---- fins (rectangular ring segments) ----
with BuildPart() as fins:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(fin_outer_radius)
        Circle(fin_inner_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=fin_height)

fin_ring = fins.part
fin_ring = Pos(0, 0, disc_thickness) * fin_ring

# cut gaps between fins -> leaves N separate fins
gap_width = (2 * math.pi * fin_center_radius) / fin_count - fin_thickness
gap_length = fin_outer_radius * 2.0
angle_step = 360.0 / fin_count

for i in range(fin_count):
    angle = i * angle_step
    gap = Box(gap_width, gap_length, fin_height + 2.0)
    gap = Rot(0, 0, angle) * Pos(fin_center_radius, 0, (disc_thickness + fin_height) / 2.0) * gap
    fin_ring = fin_ring - gap

result = result + fin_ring

# ---- radial split slot through the fins (keeps disc whole) ----
slot = Box(disc_diameter * 2, slot_width, fin_height + 2.0)
slot = Pos(0, 0, disc_thickness + fin_height / 2.0) * slot
result = result - slot

# ---- small chamfer on the fin top edges ----

import math

# --- Driving dimensions (from COBRA-420B drawing) ---
outer_diameter        = 80.0
plate_thickness       = 6.4
central_hole_diameter = 9.6
slot_width            = 4.5
slot_count            = 12
slot_inner_radius     = 19.2          # from 19.2 dim
slot_outer_radius     = 63.7 / 2.0    # Ø63.7 slot outer circle
slot_length           = slot_outer_radius - slot_inner_radius
slot_center_radius    = (slot_inner_radius + slot_outer_radius) / 2.0
fillet_radius         = 0.6           # 2x R0.6 on edges and slot corners

with BuildPart() as p:
    # Base plate
    Cylinder(radius=outer_diameter / 2, height=plate_thickness)

    # Central through hole
    Cylinder(radius=central_hole_diameter / 2,
             height=plate_thickness + 2,
             mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Radial rectangular slots (sharp corners, filleted later)
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        for i in range(slot_count):
            angle_deg = i * 360.0 / slot_count
            rad       = math.radians(angle_deg)
            cx        = slot_center_radius * math.cos(rad)
            cy        = slot_center_radius * math.sin(rad)
            with Locations((cx, cy)):
                with Locations(Rotation(0, 0, angle_deg)):
                    Rectangle(slot_length, slot_width)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Fillet slot vertical corners (R0.6)
    slot_vertical_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if slot_vertical_edges:
        fillet(slot_vertical_edges, fillet_radius)

    # Fillet plate top & bottom outer circular edges (2x R0.6)

                   if abs(e.radius - outer_diameter / 2) < 0.01]

from build123d import *
import math

# ---------- dimensions taken from the HELIOS-1245 drawing ----------
total_height = 80.0          # 80.0   overall height
total_width  = 75.0          # 75.0   overall width (top view)
left_half    = 37.9          # 37.9   left edge -> centre line
right_half   = total_width - left_half        # 37.1

thickness    = 5.8           # 5.8    plate thickness
hole_dia     = 37.1          # Ø37.1  THRU
hole_z       = 60.7          # 60.7   hole centre height
top_r        = total_height - hole_z          # 19.3  -> rounded top touches 80.0

# bottom relief arc (proportions measured from the front view)
notch_half_chord = 25.0
notch_rise       = 17.0
notch_r  = (notch_half_chord ** 2 + notch_rise ** 2) / (2.0 * notch_rise)
notch_cz = notch_rise - notch_r               # arc centre below the base

# tangent points from the bottom corners to the top circle
def tang(px, pz, sign):
    vx, vz = -px, hole_z - pz
    d  = math.hypot(vx, vz)
    L  = math.sqrt(d * d - top_r * top_r)
    a  = math.atan2(vz, vx) + sign * math.asin(top_r / d)
    return (px + L * math.cos(a), pz + L * math.sin(a))

tl = tang(-left_half, 0.0, +1)
tr = tang( right_half, 0.0, -1)

with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((-left_half, 0.0), tl)                    # left tangent flank
            ThreePointArc(tl, (0.0, total_height), tr)     # rounded top
            Line(tr, (right_half, 0.0))                    # right tangent flank
            Line((right_half, 0.0), (-left_half, 0.0))     # straight base
        make_face()
        # Ø37.1 through hole
        with Locations((0.0, hole_z)):
            Circle(hole_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        # concave relief in the bottom edge
        with Locations((0.0, notch_cz)):
            Circle(notch_r, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

part = bp.part
part.name = "tapered_arm"
export_step(part, "output.step")

def octagon(af: float, ch: float) -> Sketch:
    """Square of side `af` with 45 deg chamfered corners -> octagon."""
    h = af / 2.0
    pts = [
        ( h,  h - ch), ( h - ch,  h), (-h + ch,  h), (-h,  h - ch),
        (-h, -h + ch), (-h + ch, -h), ( h - ch, -h), ( h, -h + ch),
    ]
    return Polygon(*pts, align=None)

boss_height = 3.4                    # boss height (flush with plate)

with BuildPart() as p:
    # Outer triangle plate
    with BuildSketch() as outer_sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((-base / 2, -height / 3), (base / 2, -height / 3))
            Line((base / 2, -height / 3), (0, 2 * height / 3))
            Line((0, 2 * height / 3), (-base / 2, -height / 3))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # Inner triangle cutout -> hollow frame
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)) as inner_sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((-base / 2 + wall, -height / 3 + wall),
                 (base / 2 - wall, -height / 3 + wall))
            Line((base / 2 - wall, -height / 3 + wall),
                 (0, 2 * height / 3 - wall))
            Line((0, 2 * height / 3 - wall),
                 (-base / 2 + wall, -height / 3 + wall))

    extrude(amount=-thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as boss_sk:

from build123d import *
import math

# ----- dimensions from the drawing -----
overall_width = 80.0          # overall width across the profile
thickness = 22.1              # part thickness
hole_diameter = 43.2          # central through hole (43.2 THRU)

# interior angles of the irregular hexagonal profile (degrees, sum = 720)
interior_angles = [121.1, 118.6, 120.3, 119.6, 119.2, 121.2]

# ----- build the unit profile by walking the edges with the given turns -----
pts = []
x = y = 0.0
direction = 0.0
for a in interior_angles:
    pts.append((x, y))
    x += math.cos(math.radians(direction))
    y += math.sin(math.radians(direction))
    direction += 180.0 - a     # exterior (turn) angle at each vertex

# scale the profile so the overall width matches the drawing (80.0)
xs = [p[0] for p in pts]
ys = [p[1] for p in pts]
scale = overall_width / (max(xs) - min(xs))
cx = (max(xs) + min(xs)) / 2.0
cy = (max(ys) + min(ys)) / 2.0
profile = [((px - cx) * scale, (py - cy) * scale) for px, py in pts]

# ----- solid -----
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*profile, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)
    Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2.0, thickness * 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
length = 80.0                 # overall extrusion length

outer_half = 24.0             # half width of the square envelope
outer_size = 2 * outer_half   # 48 x 48 envelope

bar_width = 12.0              # width of each longitudinal bar
slot_width = 10.0             # width of each slot
slot_depth = 12.0             # how deep the slot reaches from the edge
slot_center = outer_half - slot_depth / 2.0   # 18.0

hole_diameter = 8.6           # central through bore

fillet_outer = 1.6            # R1.6 on the long outer corners
fillet_inner = 0.6            # R0.6 on the re-entrant (slot) corners

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- cross-section profile: square with 4 edge slots -------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as profile:
        Rectangle(outer_size, outer_size)

        # top / bottom slots
        with Locations((0, slot_center), (0, -slot_center)):
            Rectangle(slot_width, slot_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # left / right slots
        with Locations((slot_center, 0), (-slot_center, 0)):
            Rectangle(slot_depth, slot_width, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # central through bore
        Circle(hole_diameter / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- extrude along the length -----------------------------------
    extrude(amount=length)

    # ---- fillet the long (axial) edges ------------------------------
    vertical_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)

    # re-entrant edges = those lying on the slot mouths, i.e. inside the
    # outer envelope (the 12 corners of the four slots)
    inner_edges = [
        e for e in vertical_edges
        if abs(e.center().X) < outer_half - 1e-6
        and abs(e.center().Y) < outer_half - 1e-6
    ]
    outer_edges = [e for e in vertical_edges if e not in inner_edges]

    if inner_edges:
        fillet(inner_edges, radius=fillet_inner)
    if outer_edges:
        fillet(outer_edges, radius=fillet_outer)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

R_bc     = hole_bc / 2.0
R_groove = groove_dia / 2.0
r_hole   = hole_dia / 2.0

mid = total_length / 2.0

# revolved half-profile (x = radius, y = axial)
profile = [
    (R_cbore, 0.0),
    (R_body,  0.0),
    (R_body,  end_len),
    (R_knurl, end_len),
    (R_knurl, end_len + knurl_width),
    (R_body,  end_len + knurl_width),
    (R_body,  total_length),
    (R_cbore, total_length),
    (R_cbore, total_length - cbore_depth),
    (R_bore,  total_length - cbore_depth),
    (R_bore,  mid + groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_groove, mid + groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_groove, mid - groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_bore,  mid - groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_bore,  cbore_depth),
    (R_cbore, cbore_depth),
    (R_cbore, 0.0),
]

        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*profile, close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

import math

# ---- Dimensions from drawing ----
length        = 80.0     # extrusion length
size          = 26.7     # overall square envelope
half          = size / 2
r_corner      = 1.1      # 8x R1.1 outer corner fillets
r_slot        = 2.0      # 4x R2 inner slot fillets
c_lip         = 4.2      # 8x C4.2 chamfers on slot lips
hole_d        = 5.6      # central through hole

# T-slot geometry (typical for a 26.7 mm extrusion)
slot_open     = 6.2      # slot opening width
slot_inner    = 12.0     # interior channel width
slot_depth    = 9.0      # total slot depth from outer face

# ---- T-slot cross-section polygon (+X side) ----
def tslot_pts():
    return [
        ( half,               slot_open / 2 + c_lip),   # outer, wider (chamfered lip)
        ( half - c_lip,       slot_open / 2),           # after chamfer
        ( half - c_lip,       slot_inner / 2),          # channel shoulder
        ( half - slot_depth,  slot_inner / 2),          # deep inner corner (top)
        ( half - slot_depth, -slot_inner / 2),          # deep inner corner (bottom)
        ( half - c_lip,      -slot_inner / 2),          # channel shoulder
        ( half - c_lip,      -slot_open / 2),           # after chamfer
        ( half,              -(slot_open / 2 + c_lip)), # outer, wider
    ]

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- Profile: rounded square minus 4 T-slots ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        RectangleRounded(size, size, r_corner)
        for ang in (0, 90, 180, 270):
            a = math.radians(ang)
            ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
            pts = [(x * ca - y * sa, x * sa + y * ca) for x, y in tslot_pts()]
            with BuildLine():
                Polyline(*pts, close=True)
            make_face(mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    extrude(amount=length)

    # ---- Central through hole ----
    Cylinder(hole_d / 2, length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part

# ---- Fillet the deep inner corners of each T-slot channel (R2) ----
deep_edges = []
for ang in (0, 90, 180, 270):
    a = math.radians(ang)
    ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    for y in (slot_inner / 2, -slot_inner / 2):
        xr = (half - slot_depth) * ca - y * sa
        yr = (half - slot_depth) * sa + y * ca
        for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z):
            c = e.center()

from build123d import *
import math

# ----- Drawing dimensions (mm) -----
overall_radius      = 40.0          # -> 80 overall diameter to tooth tips
root_radius         = 35.0          # 5 deep sawteeth
thickness           = 4.0
num_teeth           = 30
central_hole_dia    = 22.2          # (D) 22.2 THRU
clearance_hole_dia  = 8.1           # 3x (D) 8.1 THRU
bolt_circle_radius  = 44.8 / 2.0    # EQ SP ON (D) 44.8 BC
num_clear_holes     = 3

pitch_angle = 360.0 / num_teeth
half_pitch  = pitch_angle / 2.0

# ----- Pointed sawtooth outer profile -----
pts = []
for i in range(num_teeth):
    a_tip    = math.radians(i * pitch_angle)
    a_valley = math.radians(i * pitch_angle + half_pitch)
    pts.append((overall_radius * math.cos(a_tip),
                overall_radius * math.sin(a_tip)))
    pts.append((root_radius * math.cos(a_valley),
                root_radius * math.sin(a_valley)))

profile_wire = Polyline(*pts, close=True)
profile_face = make_face(profile_wire)

part = extrude(profile_face, thickness)               # z = 0 .. thickness

# ----- Central through hole -----
part -= Pos(0, 0, 0) * Cylinder(
    central_hole_dia / 2, thickness,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ----- Equally-spaced clearance holes on the bolt circle -----
for i in range(num_clear_holes):
    ang = math.radians(90.0 + i * 360.0 / num_clear_holes)   # top, lower-left, lower-right
    px = bolt_circle_radius * math.cos(ang)
    py = bolt_circle_radius * math.sin(ang)
    part -= Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(
        clearance_hole_dia / 2, thickness,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

part.name = "gear_with_teeth_and_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
panel_width = 80.0          # overall width (X)
panel_height = 78.9         # overall height (Z)
panel_thickness = 4.0       # panel thickness (Y)

# central window (through the panel)
window_width = 53.4
window_height = 12.4
window_bottom = 44.7        # window bottom edge from panel bottom

# small rectangular connector cutouts
cutout_w = 4.0
cutout_h = 6.0
cutout_bottoms = [65.5, 12.4]
cutout_xs = [-31.0, -12.0, 12.0, 31.0]

# staggered (brick) vent field
vent_dia = 2.1
vent_spacing_x = 6.7
vent_spacing_y = 6.7
vent_cols = 9
vent_rows = 8
vent_stagger = 3.35
vent_origin_x = -30.0
vent_origin_z = 32.1

# four corner connector holes (2.0 THRU)
conn_hole_dia = 2.0
conn_hole_positions = [
    (-35.0, 72.2),
    (35.0, 72.2),
    (-35.0, 4.7),
    (35.0, 4.7),
]

# corner radii
corner_fillet = 3.3
window_fillet = 0.7

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- main panel ---------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        Rectangle(panel_width, panel_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    extrude(amount=panel_thickness)

    # --- central window (through) ------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0, window_bottom)):
            RectangleRounded(window_width, window_height, window_fillet)
    extrude(amount=panel_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- small rectangular connector cutouts -------------------------
    for cz in cutout_bottoms:
        for cx in cutout_xs:
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
                with Locations((cx, cz)):
                    Rectangle(cutout_w, cutout_h)
            extrude(amount=panel_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- staggered vent field ----------------------------------------
    for row in range(vent_rows):
        x_off = (row % 2) * vent_stagger
        z = vent_origin_z + row * vent_spacing_y
        for col in range(vent_cols):
            x = vent_origin_x + col * vent_spacing_x + x_off
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
                with Locations((x, z)):
                    Circle(vent_dia / 2)
            extrude(amount=panel_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- four corner connector holes (2.0 THRU) ----------------------
    for hx, hz in conn_hole_positions:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
            with Locations((hx, hz)):
                Circle(conn_hole_dia / 2)
        extrude(amount=panel_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- round the four outer corners (2x R3.3 per end) --------------
    corner_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
        if abs(e.center().X) > panel_width / 2 - 0.01
        and (abs(e.center().Z) < 0.01 or abs(e.center().Z - panel_height) < 0.01)
    ]
    fillet(corner_edges, corner_fillet)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
length = 80.1                 # beam length (Y)
overall_height = 55.3         # overall section height (Z)
flange_width = 55.3           # overall flange width (X)
web_thickness = 6.4           # central web thickness
flange_thickness = 2.5        # flange plate thickness
web_height = overall_height - 2 * flange_thickness   # 50.3

# 6x R3.2 concave fillets at flange-to-web junctions
root_fillet_radius = 3.2

# 3x SLOT 3.6 x 9.7  (three slots per flange half)
slot_width = 3.6
slot_length = 9.7
slot_pitch = 6.4
slots_per_half = 3

# slot group placement (from the end view)
slot_center_x = 25.6          # slot centre from section centreline
slot_center_z = 49.7          # slot centre from bottom edge  (top flange)

# small end chamfer on the flange edges running along the length
edge_chamfer = 0.4

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---------------- I cross-section, extruded along Y ----------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (-flange_width / 2,  overall_height),
                ( flange_width / 2,  overall_height),
                ( flange_width / 2,  overall_height - flange_thickness),
                ( web_thickness / 2,  overall_height - flange_thickness),
                ( web_thickness / 2,  flange_thickness),
                ( flange_width / 2,  flange_thickness),
                ( flange_width / 2,  0),
                (-flange_width / 2,  0),
                (-flange_width / 2,  flange_thickness),
                (-web_thickness / 2,  flange_thickness),
                (-web_thickness / 2,  overall_height - flange_thickness),
                (-flange_width / 2,  overall_height - flange_thickness),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=length)

    # ---------------- 6x R3.2 fillets at the web-to-flange junctions
    # (the six edges running along the extrusion direction) ----------------
    root_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
        if abs(abs(e.center().X) - web_thickness / 2) < 1e-3
        and (abs(e.center().Z - flange_thickness) < 1e-3
             or abs(e.center().Z - (overall_height - flange_thickness)) < 1e-3)
    ]
    fillet(root_edges, radius=root_fillet_radius)

    # ---------------- 3x SLOT 3.6 x 9.7 through the top flange ----------------
    with Locations(*[
        (slot_center_x, length / 2 + i * slot_pitch, overall_height - flange_thickness / 2)
        for i in range(slots_per_half)
    ]):
        Box(slot_width, slot_length, overall_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------- 3x SLOT 3.6 x 9.7 through the bottom flange ----------------
    with Locations(*[
        (slot_center_x, length / 2 + i * slot_pitch, flange_thickness / 2)
        for i in range(slots_per_half)
    ]):
        Box(slot_width, slot_length, overall_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------- small chamfer on the flange edges running along Y ----------------
    chamfer_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
        if abs(abs(e.center().X) - flange_width / 2) < 1e-3
        and (abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-3
             or abs(e.center().Z - overall_height) < 1e-3)
    ]
    chamfer(chamfer_edges, length=edge_chamfer)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

cell_pitch_y = 3 * tooth_pitch          # 10.5

cell_open_h  = tooth_width              # 1.8
