# ---- envelope (mm) ----
chord = 80.0          # leading edge -> trailing edge
tip_ht = 12.0         # half of tip-to-tip height (24.0)
root_ht = 6.0         # half of root-to-root height (12.0)
thickness = 16.5      # root airfoil thickness

# ---- internal webs ----
n_web = 13
web_xs = [chord * (0.15 + 0.7 * i / (n_web - 1)) for i in range(n_web)]   # 12.0 .. 68.0
web_thick = 2.0       # thin webs, no printed number
web_ht = tip_ht * 2.0 # span the full tip-to-tip height

# ---- root bosses (round) ----
boss_r = 1.7          # Ø3.4
boss_h = 5.0          # length, no printed number
boss_pos = 31.4       # from leading edge
boss_z = 6.6          # boss centre height

# ---- balance hole ----
bal_r = 0.7           # Ø1.4
bal_x = 21.2          # from leading edge
bal_z = -6.8          # below mid-plane

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- airfoil body (root thick, tip thin, diamond plan) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        Polygon(
            (0.0, -root_ht),
            (chord * 0.55, -tip_ht),
            (chord, -tip_ht / 2),
            (chord, tip_ht / 2),
            (chord * 0.55, tip_ht),
            (0.0, root_ht),
        )
    extrude(amount=thickness / 2, both=True)

    # ---- thin internal webs ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations(*[(x, 0.0) for x in web_xs]):
            Rectangle(web_thick, web_ht, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
    extrude(amount=thickness / 2, both=True)

    # ---- two round bosses on the root chord ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((boss_pos, boss_z), (boss_pos, -boss_z)):
            Circle(boss_r)
    extrude(amount=boss_h, both=True)

    # ---- balance hole through the boss ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((bal_x, bal_z)):
            Circle(bal_r)
    extrude(amount=thickness / 2, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Dimensions (mm) from drawing ----
gear_tip_dia     = 80.0        # tooth tip diameter (Ø80.0)
gear_root_dia    = 70.5        # root diameter (ø70.5)
hub_dia          = 45.3        # hub diameter (ø45.3)
hub_length       = 33.7        # hub axial length (33.7)
gear_width       = 16.8        # gear axial width (16.8)
tooth_count      = 34          # tooth count

bore_dia         = 16.8        # hub through bore (1× ⌀16.8)
mount_hole_dia   = 6.7         # socket centre hole (1× ⌀6.7)
socket_width     = 28.1        # across-flats of rectangular socket
socket_depth     = 20.0        # socket protrusion beyond hub end

# radii
gear_tip_r   = gear_tip_dia / 2.0
gear_root_r  = gear_root_dia / 2.0
hub_r        = hub_dia / 2.0
bore_r       = bore_dia / 2.0
mount_hole_r = mount_hole_dia / 2.0

# ---- Build ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    # 1) Gear body: alternating tip/root polygon, extruded to gear width
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            pts = []
            for i in range(tooth_count * 2):
                r = gear_tip_r if i % 2 == 0 else gear_root_r
                a = i * math.pi / tooth_count
                pts.append((r * math.cos(a), r * math.sin(a)))
            pts.append(pts[0])
            Polyline(*pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=gear_width)

    # 2) Hub cylinder
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        Circle(hub_r)
    extrude(amount=hub_length)

    # 3) Rectangular mounting socket on the free end of the hub
    with Locations((0, -(hub_length + socket_depth / 2.0), 0)):
        Box(socket_width, socket_depth, hub_dia)

    # 4) Centre hole in the socket (through the socket depth)
    with Locations((0, -(hub_length + socket_depth / 2.0), 0)):
        Cylinder(mount_hole_r, socket_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 5) Through bore of the hub (along the hub axis)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        Circle(bore_r)
    extrude(amount=hub_length + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
part.name = "gear_with_hub_and_socket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# --- Target dimensions (image 1) ---
tip_dia      = 80.0          # true outer (tip) diameter -> side view 80.0
thickness    = 11.2          # axial thickness
root_radius  = 28.0          # radius at the valley between teeth
bore_dia     = 30.0          # central bore, THRU
tooth_count  = 30            # number of sharp teeth
phase        = 180.0 / tooth_count   # half-pitch offset (6 deg):
                                     # a tooth tip on the vertical axis -> side view 80.0,
                                     # no tip on horizontal axis -> front view 80*cos6 = 79.6

tip_radius = tip_dia / 2.0
step_angle = 360.0 / tooth_count

# Toothed rim as a closed zig-zag polyline (tip / root alternating)
points = []
for i in range(tooth_count):
    a_tip  = phase + i * step_angle
    a_root = a_tip + step_angle / 2.0
    points.append((tip_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a_tip)),
                   tip_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a_tip))))
    points.append((root_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a_root)),
                   root_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a_root))))

with BuildSketch() as sk:
    with BuildLine():
        Polyline(*points, close=True)
    make_face()
    Circle(bore_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = extrude(sk.sketch, thickness)
part.name = "toothed_wheel"
export_step(part, "output.step")

arc_center_x   = 68.0
arc_center_z   = 21.0      # mid-height

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Right-side features
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Counterbored hole (6.2 / 12.9 x 0.3)
cbore_x        = 68.0
cbore_z        = 24.8
cbore_dia      = 6.2
cbore_cbore_dia = 12.9
cbore_depth    = 0.3

# Two plain 6.2 through holes
thru_hole_positions = [(61.0, 17.5), (61.0, 33.0)]

# 4x 1.2 through holes
hole_1p2_positions = [
    (55.0, 12.0), (55.0, 36.0),
    (71.0, 12.0), (71.0, 36.0),
]

# 4x 1.0 through holes (left block)
hole_1p0_positions = [
    (5.0, 10.0), (5.0, 30.0),
    (13.0, 10.0), (13.0, 30.0),
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pocket
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
pocket_x       = 48.0
pocket_z       = 20.0
pocket_w       = 20.0
pocket_h       = 8.0
pocket_depth   = 3.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fillets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fillet_r = 0.9

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- profile on XZ plane ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, overall_height))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (overall_width - arc_radius, overall_height))
            a1 = ThreePointArc(l2 @ 1,
                               (arc_center_x + arc_radius, arc_center_z + arc_radius),
                               (arc_center_x + arc_radius, arc_center_z))
            a2 = ThreePointArc(a1 @ 1,
                               (arc_center_x + arc_radius, arc_center_z - arc_radius),
                               (arc_center_x, 0))
            l3 = Line(a2 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # ---- counterbored hole ----
    with Locations((cbore_x, thickness - cbore_depth / 2, cbore_z)):
        Cylinder(cbore_cbore_dia / 2, cbore_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    with Locations((cbore_x, thickness / 2, cbore_z)):
        Cylinder(cbore_dia / 2, thickness + 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- plain 6.2 through holes ----
    for x, z in thru_hole_positions:
        with Locations((x, thickness / 2, z)):
            Cylinder(cbore_dia / 2, thickness + 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 1.2 through holes ----
    for x, z in hole_1p2_positions:
        with Locations((x, thickness / 2, z)):
            Cylinder(1.2 / 2, thickness + 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 1.0 through holes ----
    for x, z in hole_1p0_positions:
        with Locations((x, thickness / 2, z)):
            Cylinder(1.0 / 2, thickness + 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- pocket ----
    with Locations((pocket_x, thickness - pocket_depth / 2, pocket_z)):
        Box(pocket_w, pocket_depth, pocket_h, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- fillets on Y-parallel edges ----
    fillet(p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), fillet_r)

star_inner_radius = 8.0
star_center_y     = 30.0              # top tip of the star at +50 (80 tall overall)

# horizontal connector bar
bar_width  = overall_width            # 61.9
bar_height = 15.0
bar_center_y = 10.0                   # bottom of bar at +2.5

# tapered radial fins below the bar
fin_root_y = 5.0                      # roots buried inside the bar
fin_tip_y  = -30.0                    # tips reach this far down (overall height 80)
fin_root_half = 3.5                   # half width at root (wide)
fin_tip_half  = 1.4                   # half width at tip (narrow)

fin_tip_xs  = [-22.0, -12.0, -2.5, 2.5, 12.0, 22.0]

# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        # ---- five-point star ----
        star_pts = []
        for i in range(10):
            ang = math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 5
            r = star_outer_radius if i % 2 == 0 else star_inner_radius
            star_pts.append((r * math.cos(ang),
                             star_center_y + r * math.sin(ang)))
        with Locations((0, 0)):
            Polygon(*star_pts, align=None)

        # ---- horizontal connector bar ----
        with Locations((0, bar_center_y)):
            Rectangle(bar_width, bar_height)

        # ---- tapered radial fins ----
        for rx, tx in zip(fin_root_xs, fin_tip_xs):
            with BuildLine():
                Polyline(
                    (rx - fin_root_half, fin_root_y),
                    (rx + fin_root_half, fin_root_y),
                    (tx + fin_tip_half,  fin_tip_y),
                    (tx - fin_tip_half,  fin_tip_y),
                    close=True,
                )
            make_face()

    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

from build123d import *
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - per drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
gear_thickness    = 8.5      # plate thickness
lobe_count        = 12       # number of outer lobes
tip_radius        = 40.0     # lobe tip radius (from centre)
root_radius       = 31.0     # valley / root radius (from centre)
central_bore_dia  = 18.5     # central through bore

# two rings of three clearance holes
ring_hole_dia     = 11.4
ring1_radius      = 17.05    # inner ring  (3x)
ring2_radius      = 22.75    # outer ring  (3x)
ring_hole_count   = 3
ring1_angle       = 90.0     # both rings aligned (holes on same rays)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Smooth lobe (wave) profile: radius = root + amp * (1 + sin(n*theta))/2
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
lobe_amplitude    = tip_radius - root_radius

def lobe_radius(theta: float) -> float:
    wave = 0.5 * (1.0 + math.sin(lobe_count * theta))
    return root_radius + lobe_amplitude * wave

def lobe_profile_points(n_pts: int = 300):
    pts = []
    for i in range(n_pts):
        t = 2.0 * math.pi * i / n_pts
        r = lobe_radius(t)
        pts.append((r * math.cos(t), r * math.sin(t)))
    return pts

profile_pts = lobe_profile_points()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the gear body (loft between two identical wave profiles)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as gear:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY)                          as s1:
        Polygon(*profile_pts, align=None)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(gear_thickness))   as s2:
        Polygon(*profile_pts, align=None)
    loft()

solid_body = gear.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Central through bore
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(central_bore_dia / 2, gear_thickness * 2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two rings of three clearance holes (aligned on the same rays)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for ring_radius in (ring1_radius, ring2_radius):
    for i in range(ring_hole_count):
        ang = math.radians(ring1_angle + i * 360.0 / ring_hole_count)
        px = ring_radius * math.cos(ang)
        py = ring_radius * math.sin(ang)
        solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(
            ring_hole_dia / 2, gear_thickness * 2
        )

part = solid_body
part.name = "wave_gear"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
outer_diameter   = 80.0          # tip-to-tip diameter of the gear
outer_radius     = outer_diameter / 2.0
gear_thickness   = 7.4           # axial thickness of the gear disc
hub_diameter     = 17.0          # Ø17.0 hub
hub_radius       = hub_diameter / 2.0
hub_protrusion   = 3.7           # hub protrusion beyond the front face
bore_diameter    = 7.4           # Ø7.4 through bore
pocket_diameter  = 66.7          # Ø66.7 recess
pocket_radius    = pocket_diameter / 2.0
pocket_depth     = 4.0           # shallow recess depth

num_teeth        = 30            # 30 straight teeth
tooth_height     = 5.0           # radial tooth height
tooth_thickness  = 4.0           # tangential tooth width

num_spokes       = 4
spoke_width      = 4.0           # tangential spoke width
spoke_root_r     = hub_radius - 0.5
spoke_tip_r      = outer_radius - tooth_height - 0.5
spoke_mid_r      = (spoke_root_r + spoke_tip_r) / 2.0
spoke_length     = spoke_tip_r - spoke_root_r
spoke_fillet     = 1.5

tooth_center_r   = outer_radius - tooth_height / 2.0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Base disc
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
body = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(outer_radius, gear_thickness)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Hub protrusion on the front (+Y) face
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
body += Pos(0, gear_thickness / 2.0 + hub_protrusion / 2.0, 0) * \
        Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hub_radius, hub_protrusion)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Through bore
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
body -= Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2.0,
                                  gear_thickness + hub_protrusion + 20.0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Recessed pocket in the back (-Y) face
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
body -= Pos(0, -gear_thickness / 2.0 + pocket_depth / 2.0, 0) * \
        Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Teeth
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
for i in range(num_teeth):
    a = math.radians(i * 360.0 / num_teeth)
    body += Pos(tooth_center_r * math.cos(a), 0, tooth_center_r * math.sin(a)) * \
            Box(tooth_height, gear_thickness, tooth_thickness)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Spokes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
for i in range(num_spokes):
    a = math.radians(i * 360.0 / num_spokes)
    body += Pos(spoke_mid_r * math.cos(a), 0, spoke_mid_r * math.sin(a)) * \
            Rot(0, a, 0) * Box(spoke_length, gear_thickness, spoke_width)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Fillet spoke edges (rounded roots & tips)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
spoke_edges = []
for e in body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y):
    c = e.center()
    r = math.hypot(c.X, c.Z)
    if spoke_root_r - 0.1 <= r <= spoke_tip_r + 0.1 and \
       abs(c.Y) <= gear_thickness / 2.0 + 0.1:
        spoke_edges.append(e)

if spoke_edges:
    body = fillet(spoke_edges, spoke_fillet)

part = body
part.name = "gear_with_teeth_and_spokes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

    # outer profile with rounded corners

        RectangleRounded(length, width, corner_radius)

from build123d import *
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# overall envelope : 80 x 60, base 1.2 + raised rim 1.2  (2.4 total)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_length = 80.0
plate_width = 60.0
base_thickness = 1.2
rim_width = 2.0
rim_height = 1.2
total_thickness = base_thickness + rim_height

# 4x dia 1.2 THRU, 4 mm from each edge
corner_hole_dia = 1.2
hole_x = plate_length / 2 - 4.0          # 36
hole_y = plate_width / 2 - 4.0           # 26
corner_radius = 3.0                      # 4x R3

# decorative scroll : groove 1.2 wide, 3.2 pitch, 0.6 deep
groove_width = 1.2
pitch = 3.2
c_off = pitch / 4.0                      # half-turn radius growth / 2
start_radius = 4.0
half_turns = 13
groove_depth = 0.6

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# base plate
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part = Pos(0, 0, base_thickness / 2) * Box(plate_length, plate_width, base_thickness)

# raised border rim (76 x 56 inner opening)
rim = (Box(plate_length, plate_width, rim_height)
       - Box(plate_length - 2 * rim_width, plate_width - 2 * rim_width, rim_height))
part = part + Pos(0, 0, base_thickness + rim_height / 2) * rim

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4 x dia 1.2 corner holes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for sx in (1, -1):
    for sy in (1, -1):
        part = part - Pos(sx * hole_x, sy * hole_y, total_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(
            corner_hole_dia / 2, total_thickness + 4)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# two-centre scroll groove (alternating 180 deg arcs)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
pts = []
for k in range(half_turns):
    cx = -c_off if k % 2 == 0 else c_off
    radius = start_radius + 2 * c_off * k
    a0 = 0.0 if k % 2 == 0 else math.pi
    steps = 48
    for i in range(steps + 1):
        if k > 0 and i == 0:
            continue
        a = a0 + math.pi * i / steps
        pts.append((cx + radius * math.cos(a), radius * math.sin(a), base_thickness))

spiral = Spline(*pts)
profile = Plane(origin=spiral @ 0, z_dir=spiral % 0) * Circle(groove_width / 2)
tool = sweep(profile, path=spiral)
# tube centre sits on the base top face -> 0.6 mm deep engraving
part = part - Pos(0, 0, -(groove_width / 2 - groove_depth)) * tool

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4x R3 corner radii on the outer vertical edges
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
vert_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)

    (-114.63, 35.00),   # Colorado River

    (-124.35, 40.25),   # Cape Mendocino
    (-124.20, 41.10),   # Humboldt
    (-124.15, 41.85),   # Crescent City
]

    vertical_edges = bp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    chamfer(vertical_edges, length=chamfer_len, angle=chamfer_angle)

import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_diameter = 80.0          # gear outside diameter (tooth tip diameter)
inner_diameter = 39.0          # central bore diameter
thickness = 2.2                # gear plate thickness
tooth_count = 14               # number of teeth
tooth_width = 5.6              # tangential tooth width
tooth_height = 8.0             # radial tooth height
tooth_root_fillet = 0.7        # fillet at tooth root / flank
chamfer_size = 0.5             # axial edge chamfer

ring_outer_diameter = 44.1     # raised retaining ring OD
ring_inner_diameter = 39.0     # raised ring ID (matches bore)
ring_height = 2.2              # raised ring height

pocket_diameter = 3.6          # vent pocket diameter
pocket_count = 15              # number of vent pockets
pocket_radius = (outer_diameter / 2 + inner_diameter / 2) / 2   # pocket pitch radius
pocket_depth = thickness + 0.2 # cut through the plate

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- gear body: disc + teeth ---------------------------------
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(outer_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    for i in range(tooth_count):
        angle = i * 360.0 / tooth_count
        tooth = Rot(0, 0, angle) * Pos(outer_diameter / 2 - tooth_height / 2, 0, thickness / 2) * Box(tooth_width, tooth_height, thickness)
        p.part = p.part + tooth

    # fillet tooth roots / flanks (vertical edges)
    p.part = fillet(p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), tooth_root_fillet)

    # --- raised retaining ring on the back face -------------------
    ring = Cylinder(ring_outer_diameter / 2, ring_height) - Cylinder(ring_inner_diameter / 2, ring_height)
    p.part = p.part + Pos(0, 0, -ring_height / 2) * ring

    # --- central bore (through) -----------------------------------
    p.part = p.part - Cylinder(inner_diameter / 2, thickness + ring_height + 2)

    # --- ring of vent pockets (through) ---------------------------
    for i in range(pocket_count):
        angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / pocket_count)
        px = pocket_radius * math.cos(angle)
        py = pocket_radius * math.sin(angle)
        p.part = p.part - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(pocket_diameter / 2, pocket_depth)

    # --- chamfer axial edges (top and bottom faces) ---------------
    axial_edges = p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z, reverse=True)
    p.part = chamfer(axial_edges, chamfer_size)

    """Swept rectangular bar along a planar spline of given Y span and Z drop."""
    with BuildPart() as bp:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
            Rectangle(THK, W)
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Spline(
                (0, 0, 0),
                (0, 0.25 * length, -0.12 * drop),
                (0, 0.5625 * length, -0.52 * drop),
                (0, length, -drop),
            )
        sweep(sections=sk.sketch, path=bl.line)
    return bp.part

length = 80.0                 # overall length along X

lobe_left_x = -length / 2 + 14.1
lobe_right_x = length / 2 - 14.1
lobe_outer_r = width / 2                      # 14.05
lobe_ring_r = 10.0                            # annular boss outer radius
lobe_inner_r = 7.0                            # annular boss inner radius (ring)

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- Base plate: two lobes joined by a waist (rounded-rectangle / dogbone) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with Locations(*lobe_centers):
            Circle(lobe_outer_r)
        with BuildLine():
            Line((lobe_left_x, lobe_outer_r), (lobe_right_x, lobe_outer_r))
            Line((lobe_right_x, lobe_outer_r), (lobe_right_x, -lobe_outer_r))
            Line((lobe_right_x, -lobe_outer_r), (lobe_left_x, -lobe_outer_r))
            Line((lobe_left_x, -lobe_outer_r), (lobe_left_x, lobe_outer_r))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # ---- Rounded (rolled) top edge ----
    top_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    fillet(top_face.edges(), edge_radius)

    # ---- Annular boss rings on each lobe ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)):

    extrude(amount=1.0)

        with Locations(*lobe_centers):
            Circle(hub_r)
    extrude(amount=1.0)

    # ---- Eight small ribs around each hub ----
    rib_pts = []
    for cx, cy in lobe_centers:
        for dx, dy in ((rib_offset, 0), (-rib_offset, 0), (0, rib_offset), (0, -rib_offset),

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)):
        with Locations(*rib_pts):
            Circle(rib_r)
    extrude(amount=rib_h)

    # ---- Central through-slot (28.0 x 5.6 x 1.7 deep from the top) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness + 1.0)):

import math

# --- Overall size ---------------------------------------------------------
tooth_tip_diameter = 80.0          # tip circle of the gear teeth
base_radius        = 34.0          # radius of the gear body (root circle)
thickness          = 6.2           # plate thickness

# --- Tooth geometry -------------------------------------------------------
num_teeth     = 30                 # number of sharp pointed teeth
tooth_tip_r   = tooth_tip_diameter / 2.0
root_r        = base_radius
tooth_half    = (2 * math.pi / num_teeth) * 0.55   # half angular width of tooth
root_angle    = tooth_half * 0.35                  # where the flank leaves the root
tip_angle     = tooth_half

# --- Holes ----------------------------------------------------------------
central_hole_dia  = 5.4
vent_hole_dia     = 20.0
vent_hole_count   = 5
vent_hole_radius  = 19.15

# --- Chamfer --------------------------------------------------------------
tip_chamfer = 0.6                  # chamfer on tooth tip edges

# --- Build ----------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # Base disc
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(base_radius)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # One pointed tooth profile (triangle: two roots + tip)
    p1 = (root_r * math.cos(-root_angle), root_r * math.sin(-root_angle))
    p2 = (tooth_tip_r, 0.0)
    p3 = (root_r * math.cos(root_angle), root_r * math.sin(root_angle))
    with BuildSketch() as ts:
        with BuildLine() as tl:
            Polyline(p1, p2, p3, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # Pattern the tooth around the full circle
    for i in range(1, num_teeth):
        with Locations(Rot(0, 0, i * 360.0 / num_teeth)):
            add(p.part)

    # Central mounting hole
    with Locations((0, 0, thickness / 2)):
        Cylinder(central_hole_dia / 2, thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Five large vent holes around the centre
    for i in range(vent_hole_count):
        a = math.radians(i * 360.0 / vent_hole_count)
        with Locations((vent_hole_radius * math.cos(a),
                        vent_hole_radius * math.sin(a),
                        thickness / 2)):
            Cylinder(vent_hole_dia / 2, thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part

# --- Chamfer the tooth tip edges (edges parallel to Z at the tip radius) --
tip_edges = [e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
             if abs(math.hypot(e.center().X, e.center().Y) - tooth_tip_r) < 0.5]
if tip_edges:
    try:
        part = chamfer(tip_edges, tip_chamfer)
    except Exception:
        pass

export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# -------- dimensions from drawing --------

disc_thick = 2.4      # 2.4

petal_arc_r  = 16.7   # 6x R16.7  (arc forming each petal)
petal_tip_r  = 1.6    # 12x R1.6  (2 tip fillets per petal)
petal_off    = 9.0    # offset of the two arcs -> slot thickness
petal_pitch_r = 24.0  # radial location of the petal defining circle
petal_swirl  = 18.0   # pinwheel tilt (deg)
n_petals     = 6

# -------- petal profile: crescent of two R16.7 arcs, R1.6 tips --------
blade = Circle(petal_arc_r) - Pos(petal_off, 0) * Circle(petal_arc_r)
blade = fillet(blade.vertices(), petal_tip_r)

# -------- pattern the petals (swirled, bolt-hole style) --------
cut_sk = None
for i in range(n_petals):
    ang = i * 360.0 / n_petals
    rad = math.radians(ang)
    p = (Pos(petal_pitch_r * math.cos(rad), petal_pitch_r * math.sin(rad), 0)
         * Rot(0, 0, ang + petal_swirl) * blade)
    cut_sk = p if cut_sk is None else cut_sk + p

# -------- solid --------
disc  = Cylinder(disc_dia / 2, disc_thick)
slots = extrude(cut_sk, amount=disc_thick, both=True)
body  = disc - slots
body -= Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, disc_thick * 2)

height    = 2 * end_r     # 17.8
thk       = 2.2           # plate thickness
slot_w    = 1.8           # slot width
slot_d    = 11.9          # slot depth from top
pitch     = 3.5           # slot pitch
n_slots   = 11            # 11 slots -> 12 teeth
hole_d    = 8.9
tip_r     = 0.5           # tooth-tip fillets
corner_r  = 4.4           # top-left corner radius
lead      = 5.9           # leading solid tooth width (0 -> 5.9)

top_z = height / 2

# ---- Base strip (left edge at x = 0) ----
part = Pos(hole_cx / 2, 0, 0) * Box(hole_cx, thk, height)

# ---- Rounded right end ----
part += Pos(hole_cx, 0, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(end_r, thk)

# ---- Through hole ----
part -= Pos(hole_cx, 0, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_d / 2, thk + 10)

# ---- Slot pattern (cut from top, through thickness) ----
for i in range(n_slots):
    cx = lead + slot_w / 2 + i * pitch          # centres 6.8 .. 41.8 -> end 42.7
    cz = top_z - slot_d / 2 + 2.5               # spans top_z .. top_z - slot_d
    part -= Pos(cx, 0, cz) * Box(slot_w, thk + 2, slot_d + 5)

                if abs(e.center().X) < 1e-6 and abs(e.center().Z - top_z) < 1e-6]
if corner_edges:
    part = fillet(corner_edges, corner_r)

# ---- R0.5 fillets on tooth tips ----
tip_edges = [e for e in part.edges()
             if abs(e.bounding_box().min.X - e.bounding_box().max.X) < 1e-6
             and abs(e.center().Z - top_z) < 1e-6

            Rectangle(slot_w, slot_tall_y1 - slot_tall_y0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=thickness)
